description:
Analyze the TCP capture file '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' located in ~/Documents/captures/ for flow control statistics. Create a report file at ~/Documents/captures/flow_control_report.txt containing exactly these 8 metrics:
1. Total Packets
2. TCP Zero Window Events
3. TCP Window Update Events
4. TCP Window Full Events
5. Max TCP Window Size (raw value)
6. Min Non-Zero TCP Window Size (raw value)
7. Unique TCP Conversations
8. SYN Packets with Window Scale Option

Format the report exactly as follows:

TCP Flow Control Analysis Report
================================
Capture File: 200722_tcp_anon.pcapng
Total Packets: <number>
TCP Zero Window Events: <number>
TCP Window Update Events: <number>
TCP Window Full Events: <number>
Max TCP Window Size: <number>
Min Non-Zero TCP Window Size: <number>
Unique TCP Conversations: <number>
SYN Packets with Window Scale Option: <number>
